Address-level geometry, occupancy counts within buildings and exact category definitions are unstated. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
